enumerations.name: Analyze the given financial statement document, and extract all information related to the bank that issued this statement in the JSON schema given below. If a particular field does not exist in the document, return "null" against that field, but do not skip any field: {"bank_name": "string", "bank_hq_address": "string", "bank_support_email": "string", "cheque_payee_address": "string"}

Analyze the given financial statement document, and extract all information related to the summary of charges as the JSON schema given below. For amount fields, ensure to capture the negative amounts which are wrapped in paranthesis in the given document, with the correct minus symbol. And do not capture currency symbols for amount fields. Also If a particular field does not exist in the document, return "null" against that field, but do not skip any field: JSON Schema - {"previous_balance": "float", "payments_received": "float", "new_charges": "float", "adjustments": "float", "total_amount_due": "number", "payment_due_date": "date"}

Extract all the transaction lines from the transaction details section in this financial document. Make sure the negative amounts are capture correctly with their symbol, which would be wrapped in parantheses in this document. Do not include currency symbol in the amount fields. Extract all transaction lines as individual objects in an array, where a single line is represented as follows: [{"transaction_date": "date", "description": "string", "amount": "float"}]
Extract the address of the payee as a string, that needs to be mentioned while issuing a cheque from the given document.
